# Our Pregnancy (Bloom)

> A privacy-first, offline-capable pregnancy tracker and maternal health companion tailored for expecting mothers in India.

## Overview
Our Pregnancy (https://ourpregnancy.in) is an evidence-grounded maternal health platform built for Indian mothers and families. It integrates clinical monitoring tools, week-by-week fetal development tracking, Indian cultural and dietary contexts, government maternity schemes, and AI-assisted wellness tools into a local-first, privacy-respecting progressive web application.

## Core Navigation & Links
- [Homepage](https://ourpregnancy.in/): Comprehensive overview of features, security principles, and product highlights.
- [Team](https://ourpregnancy.in/team): The clinical advisors, maternal wellness experts, and engineers building Our Pregnancy.
- [Health Blogs](https://ourpregnancy.in/blogs): Evidence-backed articles on prenatal health, trimester milestones, Indian nutrition, and postpartum recovery.
- [Careers](https://ourpregnancy.in/careers): Open roles in engineering, clinical research, and community health.
- [Privacy Policy](https://ourpregnancy.in/privacy): Detailed information on our local-first offline architecture, data minimization, end-to-end encryption, and consent policies.
- [Terms of Service](https://ourpregnancy.in/terms): User agreement, service conditions, and medical disclaimer.

## Clinical & Daily Tracking Tools
- **Week-by-Week Gestational Timeline:** Interactive timeline calculating gestational age, trimester progress, estimated due date (EDD via LMP, conception, or ultrasound), and comparative baby size analogies.
- **Kick Counter:** Fetal movement recording with session timers and frequency tracking following standard obstetric counting protocols.
- **Contraction Timer:** Active labor tracking measuring contraction duration and frequency with automatic 5-1-1 rule alerts indicating when to head to the hospital.
- **Blood Pressure & Vitals Tracker:** Systolic, diastolic, and pulse logging with clinical range thresholds (flagging hypertension and preeclampsia risk indicators).
- **Symptom & Mood Logger:** Multi-symptom logging (nausea, fatigue, cramping, edema, etc.) paired with daily emotional state tracking.
- **Hydration & Nutrition Tracker:** Daily water consumption targets and prenatal supplement tracking (iron, folic acid, calcium, vitamins).
- **Birth Plan Builder:** Customized delivery preferences covering labor environment, pain relief options, partner involvement, and newborn immediate care.
- **Hospital Bag Checklist:** Itemized, trimester-sorted checklist categorized for mother, baby, and birth partner.

## AI & Intelligent Assistance
- **Ask Our Pregnancy AI Companion:** Conversational assistant grounded in WHO (World Health Organization) and ACOG maternal guidelines for prenatal education and peace of mind.
- **AI Food Safety Scanner:** Camera-enabled scanner analyzing grocery items, street food, and traditional Indian recipes (e.g., unpasteurized dairy, raw papaya, specific herbs) for pregnancy safety.
- **AI Indian Baby Name Explorer:** Curated database and generative naming tool supporting Sanskrit, Hindi, Urdu, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, and other regional traditions with linguistic meanings.
- **Medical Report Summarizer:** Document parser helping mothers understand lab reports (CBC, ultrasound notes, glucose tolerance tests) in plain, reassuring language.

## Indian Cultural & Institutional Support
- **Maternity Schemes Navigator:** Eligibility criteria and application steps for Indian government welfare schemes, including Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY), Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY), and Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram (JSSK).
- **Emergency Directory:** One-tap emergency dispatch contacts (108 National Ambulance, 112 National Emergency, 102 Maternity Ambulance) and nearby hospital routing.

## Privacy, Security & Data Ownership
- **Local-First Storage:** User records are stored locally on the device using IndexedDB (Dexie.js), ensuring complete functionality without internet access.
- **Zero Advertising & No Data Brokerage:** Personal medical logs are never sold or shared with data brokers.
- **Optional Cloud Backup & Partner Sync:** Encrypted cloud backup via Google Cloud Firestore with real-time peer-to-peer sync (WebRTC) for sharing updates directly with a partner or doula.
- **Explicit Consent Controls:** Granular consent mechanisms for cloud backups and AI features in compliance with DPDP (Digital Personal Data Protection) standards.

## Technical Stack
- **Frontend:** React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Lucide Icons, Framer Motion.
- **Client Database:** Dexie.js (IndexedDB) with reactive live queries.
- **Cloud Infrastructure:** Firebase Authentication, Cloud Firestore, Firebase Functions.
- **Offline / PWA:** Vite PWA with service worker caching for offline reliability.

*Maintained for LLM indexing, search agents, and automated companion discovery by the Our Pregnancy Team.*
